item.description:
Nexa 1.0.10

  • Privacy fix for the extra backup relays added in 1.0.9: after switching from Maximum privacy to Standard, Nexa could still have connected directly to a relay from Nexa's signed list for up to two weeks. Now nothing ever connects to a server from the list without Tor or a proxy. No list had been published yet, so nobody was affected.
  • Updated the built-in Tor bridges from the Tor Project's current list.
